description: Full macro and market intelligence briefing from the DPX Stability Oracle. Use when you need more than a go/hold signal — when an agent needs to reason about why conditions are as they are, or when the task involves macro-aware decisions: treasury strategy, investment timing, large settlement approval, risk assessment, geopolitical exposure analysis. Covers climate and environmental signals with 30–90 day lead time, commodities, macroeconomic conditions, FX and currency stability, basket peg verification, bond yields and yield curve, infrastructure stress, geopolitical risk and conflict, and USD structural health. Returns signal scores, chaos regime flag, active alerts, and AI synthesis briefing. ESG Oracle is a separate system — use esg.score for counterparty ESG data.
name: oracle.status
